item.description:
Dax 3.9.8

  • Control your Mac from your iPhone or iPad. With Dax Companion 1.3, the Mac page shows your screen live; tap it for full screen and use it like a trackpad, with clicks, drags, scrolling and typing. Turn it on in Settings › iPhone & iPad.
  • Unlock your Mac from your phone. When the Mac is locked, tap Unlock and confirm with Face ID; Dax types your password into the lock screen and shows a notice on the Mac. Off until you turn on “Let my devices unlock this Mac”.
  • Free space from your phone: Dax finds build files, old temporary files, caches and the Trash, shows its progress as it goes, and clears what you pick.
  • Keep awake is on by default and now stops the screen locking, not just the Mac sleeping.
  • Tap Agents on your phone’s Mac page to bring Dax to the front.
  • Agent Watch draws each folder in its herd’s colour.
